video_title: "Hit Him In THE RIBS" - Do The Knicks Need An ENFORCER For Wemby?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' physicality drained the energy from the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: the most important thing that drained the energy out the arena, and it was the damn physicality
quotes.quote: Outside the arena, you could feel the energy. Inside the arena, it wasn't what I was expecting. It could have been because of a lot of things that drained the energy out the arena, but I'm going to tell you the most important thing that drained the energy out the arena, and it was the damn physicality of the San Antonio Spurs. It was the tone being set, not just by Wembanyama, but Stefan Castle. He set the tone from the jump, the way that he was driving to the basket, you could tell he was looking to be aggressive in the paint.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' new arena atmosphere is different from Oakland's
quotes.excerpt: they had a different energy than these new fans do in that new beautiful arena
quotes.quote: They priced out the real Knicks fans. They priced them out. When you go to like Oracle Arena in Oakland, those fans are, and I'm saying they're better or worse, they had a different energy than these new fans do in that new beautiful arena that Golden State has. Not better, not worse, it's just a fact.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks players were physically dominated by the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: a message was sent and the New York fans felt that
quotes.quote: When Carter came in the game and trucked, I think it was, I forgot who he trucked, he trucked them twice, Karl-Anthony Towns, when Wembanyama mushed Brunson, when Stefan Castle mushed and threw somebody else out, a message was sent and the New York fans felt that. It was the first time I've seen New York get punched in the stomach and back up and be like, 'No, we ain't got it today.'

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks must have an enforcer to protect Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: you cannot let Wembanyama mush your star player in his head like that
quotes.quote: You cannot let Wembanyama mush your star player in his head like that all 6'1 and Wembanyama don't get hit to the ribs. He got to get hit in the ribs. Somebody, Jordan Clarkson, Mitchell Robinson, take that flagrant and you just got to point at him, lick for a lick.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's leadership and ability to take over games
quotes.excerpt: let me remind people that Jalen Brunson could do whatever the hell he want to do
quotes.quote: It's been a lot of people criticizing Jalen Brunson for having a moment. Let me remind people that Jalen Brunson could do whatever the hell he want to do. Jalen Brunson could do what the fuck he want to do. If he want to come out in the game three and he want to put up 25 to 30 FGAs and he want to say, 'You want to know what? I'm coming into this motherfucker and this is what's about to happen. Win, lose, or draw, I'm trying to go win this game for my team.' Nobody should say a damn word.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Small players being physical is difficult for big men
quotes.excerpt: we hate when smaller guys get physical and get into our fucking legs
quotes.quote: The worst thing in the world for any type of big in the game, Allie, Channing, myself, we hate when smaller guys get physical and get into our fucking legs. It is hard. And when they're allowed to play with the type of physicality that Kelvin Johnson was allowed to play with, it is hard to get a touch. It is hard to get your offensive game off.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks need to feature Karl-Anthony Towns more
quotes.excerpt: you need to make sure that big fella right there gets 15 to 20 shots a game
quotes.quote: You can shoot those shots when Karl-Anthony Towns is also being featured. You cannot shoot those shots saying, 'I need to get off.' You need to make sure that big fella right there gets 15 to 20 shots a game, great shots. You got to figure it out.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks need Karl-Anthony Towns to be the star
quotes.excerpt: Stefan Castle and Stefan Castle have to be aggressive, they have to act like they're the star
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns and Stefan Castle have to be aggressive, they have to act like they're the star. Wembanyama is like, 'I could, what you need me to do? Shoot? I can shoot.' He's such a team player that if he were to say, 'I'm going to take over,' it would stop their whole offense.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks teammates utilized the horn set well
quotes.excerpt: Stefan Castle came off looking to get downhill
quotes.quote: His teammates did an excellent job of utilizing that horn set because a lot of times they were looking off, coming off probing to see about the lob to Wembanyama. Last night, Stefan Castle came off looking to get downhill, and once he got downhill a few times, all of a sudden it opened it up for Wembanyama to catch lobs. They didn't overreact when Josh Hart made shots, and they just kept it going. You just got to give all the credit to the San Antonio Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks need to play like the Warriors of old
quotes.excerpt: they have to play like more like the Warriors of old and not like the Knicks of last year
quotes.quote: They have to play like more like the Warriors of old and not like the Knicks of last year. Carl-Anthony Towns sitting to the side, Jalen Brunson goes to his bag, does what he does, and they put pressure on him and they say, 'Be inefficient.' That's not how they win. They have to play like more like the Warriors of old and not like the Knicks of last year.
